summary: Shovel Knight entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Shovel Knight
entries.definitive_edition: Shovel Knight: Treasure Trove on PC

emulation.notes: Native PC route; emulate legacy Nintendo ports only for platform comparison.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: PC Treasure Trove with exact build and campaign recorded

primary.why: Treasure Trove is the complete currently available Shovel Knight package, bundling Shovel of Hope with the later campaigns and Showdown. Shovel of Hope DX is announced but still listed as to be announced on Steam, so it should not replace the current archive route yet.
primary.how_to_play: Use Shovel Knight: Treasure Trove on PC for the full route. Record storefront/build, campaign, challenge/body-swap settings, input, resolution/scaler, platform-exclusive content if compared, and whether Shovel of Hope DX was only noted as pending.

secondary.platform: Nintendo 3DS / Wii U / PlayStation / Xbox / Switch
secondary.exclusive_content: Platform-specific ports, including some exclusive cameos/features
secondary.what_to_play: Use for platform-comparison coverage after the PC complete route.
secondary.why: PC Treasure Trove is the most flexible capture route.

secondary.platform: Shovel Knight: Shovel of Hope DX
secondary.exclusive_content: Announced enhanced edition with extra characters, online multiplayer, rewind, and save states
secondary.what_to_play: Do not use as primary until it is released and separately researched.
secondary.why: It is not the available baseline route as of this checkpoint.

all_releases.reason: primary: historical baseline for the first campaign.
